lua: nova.named('van'):teleport(4.5, -160, 0); local s = nova.scene_now(); local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.x, p.z = s:van_point(s.DOOR); s:get_in()

route.capture: gear-P: just in, standing in P, the needle at 0, the handbrake lamp off
gear-R: A into R (no pedal), R2 backs up: the needle at the reverse speed
gear-D-standstill: A into D, held still on the brake
creep-D: the brake let go, it creeps at idle
gear-L: D to L on the move
handbrake: B held, the lamp lit
refused: X up to N on the move, then into R refused: 'Stop to shift'
stopped on the brake in N: Get out above the cluster
